samples.question: Light falls straight down this picture from above. Every ledge sticks out to the right from the dark wall; the yellow part of a ledge is the part the light reaches, and a ledge drawn all grey stands wholly in the shadow of the ledges above it. Five ledges carry a black tag, numbered 1 to 5 from the top. Take away exactly one tagged ledge, leave every other ledge where it is, and count the wholly shadowed ledges that then catch some light. Which tagged ledge frees the most shadowed ledges? Answer with the tag number alone: 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.
